prompt_text: Best nonprofit CRM with email and text messaging
response_text:
Several **nonprofit CRMs with integrated email and text messaging capabilities** are available, with top options including Bonterra, Givebutter, Bloomerang, and Virtuous[1][4][5][6][7][9].

**Bonterra Development + Digital** stands out as a unified CRM specifically designed for nonprofits, offering donation website management, email, fundraising, and advocacy tools alongside SMS integration in a single platform[5].

**Givebutter** provides bulk email capabilities combined with CRM functionality tailored for donor engagement at scale[7]. **Virtuous** integrates email marketing directly into its CRM system, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution beyond standalone email tools[9].

For text messaging specifically, **Tatango** is purpose-built for nonprofit fundraising with mass texting capabilities and 17+ years of sector experience[8]. Many nonprofit marketing platforms also support donor segmentation, campaign attribution, and fundraising reporting alongside email and SMS features[3].

When choosing a platform, consider features like marketing automation, real-time analytics, mail merge capabilities, and batch processing to streamline your communication strategy[2][3]. Comparing options like HubSpot CRM, CiviCRM, Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, and Bitrix24 may also help you find the best fit for your organization's specific needs[10].
